title: All Fonts
description: Adds direct runtime for .ttf and .otf font rendering for the beta 1.7.3 text renderer.
body:
## About
**All fonts** replaces the old bitmap-only text system with true runtime TrueType and OpenType font rendering.
You can load .ttf/.otf files directly and see the result instantly in-game.

## Features
- Font size, scale, and vertical offset are configurable at runtime.
- Anti-aliasing and linear filtering can be toggled on or off.
- All changes apply live without restarting the game.

## Misc

### How to use custom fonts?
Place your ttf/otf fonts inside the /font directory of a texture pack; Loading that texture pack will apply the font. Using the config in Mod Menu, you can easily tweak the scale and positioning of the font. If you use [Animated Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/animated-menu), you can place all your fonts in its font config folder and it will override the texture pack's choosen font (allowing you to easily swap between just the fonts).  


### Warning:
If **[Font Fixer](https://modrinth.com/mod/font-fixer)** is installed, the mod will not work!
